In detail

Devon & Cornwall Police recorded 100 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 3.8 per 1,000 residents, the 18th highest rate of Plymouth's 20 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (2), burglary (1), vehicle crime (1); the evening/night score by violent crime (14), anti social behaviour (3), public order (3). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Plympton Erle safe?

Wandroz currently rates Plympton Erle in Plymouth as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Plymouth, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from Devon & Cornwall Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

At night, Plympton Erle is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Plymouth. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
